card.name: Words that start a formal clause
card.fires_on: Short function words or verbs that open a new statement, such as 'must', 'The', 'who suffer' or 'monitor', right after a heading, colon, quote mark or news dateline bracket. The word to be predicted next is a verb or noun in formal, instructional prose.

modes.description: A modal or verb that follows a drug name or relative pronoun in label directions.

modes.description: The word 'The' starting a quoted or example sentence.

modes.label: Closing bracket of news dateline
modes.description: The close parenthesis after Reuters in a news dateline.
